main_text.p: Vsquequò Iehouah clamabo, & non exaudies? uociferabor ad te uim patiens, & non saluabis?
main_text.head: DE TENTATIONE, IN QVA Sancti sibi uidentur à Deo negligi ac deseri.
main_text.p: Vt quales sint Sancti in rebus secundis & aduersis, & quàm sit Deus mirabilis in operibus suis, innotescat serui eius: subitis rerum conuersionibus & diuturnis afflictionibus eosdem exercet. Nos docendi causa, Tentationis istius Protasin, Epitasin & Catastrophen, ἐμφα-[?] λακωνικῶς[?] proponemus.

Ita ingenium est hominum, ut animadversis animi & corporis externis dotibus & præsidijs, maiores spiritus concipiant, quàm oportebat. Hos autem alit memoria præclarè factorum, applausus hominum, & successus in consilijs & actionibus publicis & priuatis: quæ omnia faciunt, ut liberaliter nobis lætos euentus spe quasi despondeamus, immemores fanè fati fortisq; futurae. Nec hoc rerum statu æquam mentem seruamus, sed quibus uisum est impensè fauemus :

page.notes: The Greek word at the end of the first line of the paragraph "Vt quales" is partly unclear: the hyphenated first part is read as ἐμφα- with [?], and the second word as λακωνικῶς with [?]. The Greek on the scan is faint. The catchword "cæte-" is at the foot on the right and is not repeated in the text. The printed space before the colon in "fauemus :" is kept as printed.
